name: dock-nav
title: Dock Nav
description: A floating, physics-magnified dock in the shape of macOS's own: icons grow the closer your cursor gets to them, tracked per-icon off a single shared pointer position, and pop upward as they magnify. Scroll the panel and it tucks itself out of view, then springs back the moment you scroll up, the same behavior you'd get pinning it `fixed` to the bottom of a real page.
